timing: after training-entry skeleton creation but before model implementation completion, synthetic tests, GPU smoke, formal training, or validation
reason: freeze implementation details that materially affect the LoMix training objective before any execution

final_head.decoder_128: existing network.conv_final Norm-Act-Conv; no new final auxiliary head

upsampling: F.interpolate with explicit size equal to final logits spatial shape, mode=trilinear, align_corners=false

stable_order.alpha: one zero-initialized scalar per map in exact 19-map order

attention: for each concrete subset of size k, concatenate binary raw logits to [B,k,D,H,W], apply independently registered Conv3d(k,k,kernel_size=1,bias=true), softmax over dim=1, and sum attention_i * logit_i

initialization.sequence: load historical plain model; create aux heads in 32,64 order; create concat and attention modules in subset order; create alpha in map order
initialization.rng_reset: reset Python, NumPy, CPU torch, and CUDA torch RNG to 20260846 after all model construction and before the first batch

optimizer.members: plain deploy model plus 2 aux heads plus 4 concat modules plus 4 attention modules plus 19 alpha
optimizer.learning_rate: same frozen late-cosine LR for all members
optimizer.gradient_clip: global norm 5.0 over all optimizer parameters

loss.aggregation: un-normalized sum; do not divide by 19 or by sum of weights
loss.gradient_gate: for every training-only parameter tensor including alpha: grad is not null, all finite, and norm greater than zero on deliberately asymmetric synthetic data and real batch8 smoke

checkpoint_payload: deploy-only model state plus full LoMix wrapper state and diagnostics; optimizer state is not saved; four checkpoints plus reports remain under the preregistered 0.25 GiB disk estimate
